selection_evidence: v10 unicycle (faithful flat protocol, primary): curved BVP edges, exact |v|<=1 and |omega|<=1.5 along every edge, heading-aware metric (metric_mode 2), VAMP-style range clipping 1.5 m, velocity proposals |v| in [0.01, 1], boundary lift 0.6 m/s backward chart. Selected by the pre-declared work rule: results/diagnostics/unicycle_faithful_v10/selection.json (rounds declared in config/ablation_unicycle_faithful_v10*.json). DynoBench goal epsilon 0.2 (Dynoplan sst_v0.yaml). Earlier evidence retained: results/diagnostics/ablation_v8 (dev seeds 1001-1010, benchmarks/ablation_v8.py): unicycle stop-turn-go (first-order unicycle1 stops and turns in place at nodes; straight edges have zero yaw rate) solves 10/10 on both cases for every variant with 100% independent original-model validation; extension range 1.5 m has the least work among {0.35, 1.5, 6.0}. Pure-sphere shell cover yields identical search work (iterations, edges) to the filled cover on all aerial cases and variants. v7 evidence: results/diagnostics/ablation_low_dof_v7 (dev seeds 1001-1010): unicycle disk sampling + reverse chart + lift 1.0 was the only configuration solving 10/10 on both unicycle cases; spatial-only edge sampling leaves search work unchanged and is the authors' validSegmentCount rule; keeping the SST* graph across phases did not help and is not adopted.
